items.title: 'Could bring down Charles': Royal biographer's warning over Andrew's emails
items.description: The scandal surrounding Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor has the potential to end the reign of King Charles III, claims a British historian who wrote an unofficial biography of the former prince.

items.title: UK government quietly updates passport rules for dual citizens — again
items.description: Travellers with both an expired UK passport, issued in 1989 or later, as well as a valid passport from a country that can issue an Electronic Travel Authorisation, may now be allowed to enter the UK.

items.title: Lesbians have a 'human right' to exclude trans women, Federal Court hears
items.description: A Victorian-based lesbian group is seeking an exemption to the Sex Discrimination Act so it can legally discriminate against transgender women when it holds public events.

items.title: More details emerge about 'mind-blowing' Mar-a-Lago shooting
items.description: Austin Tucker Martin was seen at the Mar-a-Lago resort's north gate at about 1:30am on Sunday, local time. He has been described as being from a family of "big Trump supporters".

items.title: Deal done on $1.5b Trump Tower for Gold Coast, says developer
items.description: Plans are afoot for a $1.5 billion, 91-storey Trump Tower in Surfers Paradise, which would be one of Australia's tallest towers if it goes ahead.

items.title: He was gynaecology's open secret. Now women and colleagues are speaking out
items.description: Complaints had been made about this gynaecologist for years. Only when hospital management discovered that Four Corners was looking into his practice, did it start investigating further.

items.title: Sydney to Newcastle high-speed rail to be 'shovel-ready' in two years
items.description: The federal government adds fresh funds to the hundreds of millions of dollars spent planning for a high-speed rail line between Sydney and Newcastle, pledging to have the project shovel-ready within two years.

items.title: Baby unresponsive at day care may have died from bacterial infection, inquest told
items.description: A baby who died after being found unresponsive at a Sydney day care may have had a bacterial infection, an inquest has heard.

items.title: Heavy rain soaks the Barkly and Central Australia, closing roads and inundating cattle stations
items.description: A tropical low circling over south-eastern parts of the Northern Territory is continuing to bring damaging winds and heavy local rainfall in the Simpson and parts of the Barkly and Tanami areas.

items.title: Andrew's daughters to be shielded by King Charles
items.description: Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor's arrest has cast another long shadow over the York family. While his ex-wife, Sarah Ferguson, has vanished from public view, their daughters Beatrice and Eugenie face an uncertain future.

items.title: Gordon Brown writes to police urging probe into Andrew over Epstein flights
items.description: Former British prime minister Gordon Brown urges British police to investigate whether Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor used taxpayer-funded jets and Royal Air Force bases to meet with convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein.

items.title: Chaos across all levels of the cartel after Mexican drug lord eliminated
items.description: Nemesio Rubén Oseguera Cervantes died after a gunfight with military personnel. Hours later, vehicles were set alight, roads blocked and shopfronts torched as retaliation in eight states.

items.title: Islamophobia envoy defends Ramadan invite to Pauline Hanson
items.description: Muslim Australians fear Islamophobia is rising following comments made by One Nation leader Pauline Hanson and in the wake of recent threats against one of Australia's largest mosques.

items.title: Childcare boss unaware of number of breaches at centres, senate inquiry told
items.description: The Affinity Education Group chief executive Glen Hurley told the Brisbane inquiry — which is examining the quality and safety of early childhood education and care systems — he would have to take the question on notice.

items.title: How becoming friends with an 82-year-old made age seem irrelevant
items.description: Headlines often highlight the divisions between older and younger Australians, but research suggests intergenerational friendships can help to reduce age-based discrimination in both directions, while offering other benefits.

items.title: Forget sides, these four salads are satisfying meals
items.description: If you’re after a healthy and summery dinner, these salads are a meal in a bowl and will tempt even the salad avoiders.

items.title: BAFTAs Film Awards see best actor upset, Aussies miss out
items.description: British actor Robert Aramayo has beaten frontrunners Timothée Chalamet and Leonardo DiCaprio to take the leading actor BAFTA.

items.title: The Lion King musical returns to Sydney for a third time
items.description: The Lion King musical makes its return to Sydney in April with the cast and crew opening its doors to rehearsals for a sneak peak.

items.title: Three people badly hurt after ATV crash on Sunshine Coast
items.description: Emergency services have responded to a serious ATV crash on the Sunshine Coast that left multiple people with life-threatening injuries.

items.title: Police bodycam video shows force used on hit-and-run driver
items.description: Body-camera footage released by the ACT Supreme Court shows tactical police officers using force on a handcuffed hit-and-run driver outside St Edmund's College.

items.title: Badger bid to replace outgoing Greens senator
items.description: The ABC understands Tasmanian Greens MP Tabatha Badger is among the names vying to replace outgoing federal senator Peter Whish-Wilson.

items.title: Police to scour mine shafts in search for missing outback mum
items.description: Police will scour several mine shafts near the outback South Australian town of Andamooka in the latest search for missing mother Trisha Graf.

items.title: How Milano Cortina's dispersed Games will impact Brisbane 2032
items.description: The 2026 Milano Cortina Winter Olympics Games was the first to follow a dispersed model. With Brisbane 2032 also set to have this set up, there are plenty of things to be aware of.

items.title: 'Deeply embarrassed' Richmond forward banned over drink driving charge
items.description: Mykelti Lefau is banned for two matches after a drink driving charge that will see him miss a pre-season clash as well as round one.

items.title: Childcare worker extradited from Fiji returns to Qld on rape charge
items.description: A Fijian national charged over the alleged rape of a child four years ago returns to Australia.
